column3: Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew names a heart; BSB says mind.
The Hebrew names his friend in the singular; BSB says my friends.
The Hebrew describes contempt for calamity and a push for those slipping; BSB describes misfortune as their fate.
